body: Tank archetype, kit follow-on to the TYLER lore entry. Passive flat armor, Q melee root+poke, W toggle armor stacking on passive, R self-root+survive-floor (literal translation of the lore's 'absorbing hits meant for somebody else' line). ARENA_HERO_COUNT 25->26. 6 new tests incl. a real-lethal-damage survival check. Full suite 379 checks, live match confirmed MnM drafted among 20 distinct zero-duplicate picks. Commit 14cb6ea.
title: MnM, the Shapeshifting Crab, 26th hero (S170-134)
